title: Adams Bridge (chipsalliance/adams-bridge)
_note: chipsalliance's post-quantum (ML-DSA / Dilithium) accelerator, SystemVerilog.  Vendored inside caliptra-rtl (submodules/adams-bridge) where only its instances inside caliptra_top are measured; this family scores its own modules: the NTT, samplers, encoders/decoders, SHA3 and the abr_top wrapper.  Pinned at the commit caliptra-ss's caliptra-rtl vendors.  UVMF / testbench trees are excluded as sources.  Two rows are excluded on purpose: bytewrite_tdp_ram_rf is declared inside `ifdef RV_FPGA_OPTIMIZE in abr_1r1w_be_ram.sv (not a module under the sweep's defines), and abr_prim_lc_sync imports lc_ctrl_state_pkg, a Caliptra / OpenTitan package this repository does not carry.  The two SRAM models are always_srcs: abr_mem_top instantiates them only through the `ABR_MEM / `ABR_MEM_BE macros of abr_config_defines.svh, an INCLUDED file the closure's .sv/.v identifier scan never reads (the same route caliptra-ss takes for caliptra_prim_ram_1p_pkg).

abr_piso_multi.note: adjudicated 2026-10-25: the co-sim divergences (33 in the nightly, 37 locally) all follow a cycle where the 3-bit `mode` input is 5, 6 or 7 -- NUM_MODES is 5, so `INPUT_RATES[mode]` / `OUTPUT_RATES[mode]` read past the end of the parameter arrays: X by the LRM, X on read_uhdm and read_slang alike (eval of the reduced shape), rendered differently by Verilator (ours advanced buffer_wr_ptr by 80).  With mode constrained to its five legal values the RTL, read_uhdm and read_slang netlists agree on every one of 300 cycles.  Unlisted-selector stimulus artefact, same class as the OpenTitan IP library's enum inputs, not a reader defect
